title: CAN MACHINES THINK LIKE HUMANS? A BEHAVIORAL EVALUATION OF LLM AGENTS IN DICTATOR GAMES

bias_targets.methodology: Regression analysis evaluating how varying the assigned age of the LLM persona (from 20 to 60) affects the proportion of money transferred in a simulated dictator game compared to human baselines.
Regression analysis comparing the generosity of LLM agents in a dictator game when they are prompted to adopt a female versus a male persona.
Regression analysis measuring how assigning different education levels and household incomes to the LLM persona influences the amount of money it chooses to transfer in a simulated dictator game.
Evaluating the effect of social distance framings (e.g., interacting with a stranger, a stranger they will meet afterward, or a friend) on the LLM's prosocial behavior and generosity.
